panels.title: Truth fraud caught by risk against missed

targets.rawSql:
SELECT toStartOfDay(started_at) AS time,
  countIf(truth_is_fraud AND outcome = 'declined' AND decline_source = 'DECLINE_SOURCE_RISK') AS caught,
  countIf(truth_is_fraud AND outcome = 'succeeded') AS missed
FROM marts.fact_payment_attempt WHERE $__timeFilter(started_at) GROUP BY time ORDER BY time

panels.description: Simulation truth is a synthetic oracle.

panels.title: Chargeback rate

targets.rawSql:
SELECT toDateTime(day) AS time,
  if(min(chargeback_window_complete), sum(chargebacks) / nullIf(sum(succeeded), 0), NULL) AS complete,
  if(min(chargeback_window_complete), NULL, sum(chargebacks) / nullIf(sum(succeeded), 0)) AS provisional
FROM marts.fact_merchant_day WHERE $__dateFilter(day) GROUP BY day ORDER BY day

panels.description: Denominator: succeeded attempts. Days less than 21 days old are provisional.

panels.title: Risk decision against truth

targets.rawSql:
SELECT risk_outcome,
  countIf(truth_is_fraud) AS fraud,
  countIf(NOT truth_is_fraud) AS legitimate,
  round(countIf(truth_is_fraud) / count(), 4) AS fraud_share
FROM marts.fact_payment_attempt
WHERE $__timeFilter(started_at) AND truth_is_fraud IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY risk_outcome ORDER BY risk_outcome

panels.description: Simulation-truth labelled attempts by risk outcome. The historical policy is rule-based and records no risk score.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT truth_scenario, count() AS attempts,
  countIf(outcome = 'succeeded') AS succeeded
FROM marts.fact_payment_attempt WHERE $__timeFilter(started_at) AND truth_scenario IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY truth_scenario ORDER BY attempts DESC
